protocol.purpose: Compare receipt and seven-record quarantine fixes with the active 55-feature country production recipe without promotion or changing Hong Kong bets.
protocol.primary: Paired 2026 quarterly historical replay, refitting at January/April/July/October boundaries using only earlier prediction times and labels available strictly before each boundary.
protocol.secondary: Annual 2026 replay reuses each January fit. Report senior World Tour, World Tour R32, junior-tagged and discipline subgroups descriptively.
protocol.training: Same production LightGBM parameters and feature schema. Availability-purged chronological internal early stopping, then refit all eligible training rows with selected iterations. Training-only country vocabularies. No new tuning or feature search.
protocol.evaluation_population: Identical non-quarantined 2026 fixtures in both variants, with identical frozen labels, prediction times and result-availability times. A quarantined result is never an evaluation target in either variant.
protocol.uncertainty: 5000 paired tournament-edition/year bootstrap resamples crossed with five seed resamples. Seeds do not multiply match counts. Subgroup intervals are exploratory, not multiplicity adjusted.
protocol.final_candidate: Separate all-clean-data seed-42 refit using the production 500-tree parameters at the same data cutoff. Never score either all-data artifact on its own historical training rows.
protocol.hong_kong: Original forecasts, odds, reports, pending bets and accounting remain byte-for-byte frozen. Optional new shadow-probability comparison is stored only in this experiment directory and does not select or record bets.
protocol.limitations: All historical years have been reused during model development. These are matched retrospective diagnostics, not independent forward validation or a profitability test. Actual post-training accuracy is unavailable until future outcomes occur.

cohort.receipt_snapshot: Explicit final status required and fingerprinted; legacy receipts require exact cached-response proof
